Locations

The studio is located at 123 Main Street, Springfield.

Free parking is available in front of the studio.

Parents may use the designated drop-off area near the entrance.

Office Address is 123 Main Street, Springfield.

Studio hours

The studio is open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

Saturday classes are available from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

The studio is closed on Sundays.

Plan your trial

New students are eligible for one free trial class.

Trial classes must be scheduled 24 hours in advance.

Students should wear comfortable clothing for their trial class.
